common_gotchas: If a visible device produces no stream, another application may already be using it.
Use Info DAT/Info CHOP to inspect detected devices, performance, and embedded timecode where available.
Vendor support is platform-dependent; some capture drivers are Windows-only or macOS-limited.
On-demand sync-to-frame can stall the TouchDesigner process and should be used sparingly.
Multi-input sync requires supported devices and genlocked sources.
Imaging Source is listed as not supported, IDS GigE Vision is not supported, and Allied Vision support is PvAPI rather than Vimba.
Ximea options are camera-specific and should not be generalized to every driver.
key_concepts: Video Device In TOP captures live video from cameras, capture cards, dongles, IP cameras, and decoders.
Multiple Device In TOPs can capture simultaneously, with Info DAT and Info CHOP used for device, status, performance, and timecode diagnostics.
Driver, signal-format, pixel-format, color-space, transfer, memory, and sync parameters are vendor and platform dependent.
Sync Inputs is intended for supported devices with genlocked sources so frames from multiple inputs arrive together.
